intro: Plan waves to land on one target in one second, in order: the trap clearers first, then the main army, then the loyalty waves. Start a plan below, then add waves to it from any of your cities. Each wave lands a thousandth of a second after the one before, so the order holds whoever sends first; each player sends their own.
noWaves: No waves yet: add one with Add a wave.

status.late: Too late: it can no longer land in time

sent: Waves sent: they wait at home and leave in time
deleteDescription: Its waves not yet sent are dropped; armies already sent march on.
